name: Enquiry received: internal notification
description: Sent to the Vitalos team whenever a new enquiry is submitted through the website form.
subject: New enquiry: {{intent}} · {{full_name}}, {{organisation}} · {{reference}}

blocks.text: {{full_name}}
{{organisation}}
{{goal}}

footer_notice: Internal notification. The enquiry is stored in the Vitalos database; this email is not the record.

name: Enquiry acknowledgement
description: For the enquirer after they submit the website form, confirming receipt and explaining what happens next.
subject: We have your enquiry ({{reference}})
preheader: What happens next, and how to reach us in the meantime.

blocks.text: Thanks, {{first_name}}
Thank you for getting in touch with Vitalos. A senior member of the team will read your enquiry properly before replying, rather than sending you a standard pack.

blocks.title: What happens next
items: We read what you have shared and think about where we could genuinely help.
We reply with a few clarifying questions or a suggested time to talk.
If a conversation makes sense, the first call is about understanding your situation, not selling to you.

blocks.text: For your records, this is what you told us:
{{goal}}
You are welcome to book a call now rather than wait for our reply. If anything changes in the meantime, reply to this email and quote your reference.

name: Meeting booked confirmation
description: Sent when a call has been booked, confirming the time, the joining link and how to change it.
subject: Confirmed: our call on {{meeting_time}}
preheader: Joining details, what to expect, and how to change the time if you need to.

blocks.text: You are booked in, {{first_name}}

Thank you for making time to speak with us. The details are below; add them to your calendar so the call does not get lost in a busy week.

To make the most of the time:
- Come with the problem as you see it today. There is no need to prepare slides.
- Invite colleagues who will be close to the decision or the work.
- If a document would help explain the context, reply with it beforehand. Nothing confidential is needed at this stage.
If the time no longer works, choose another with the link above or reply to this email.

name: Meeting reminder: 24 hours before
description: Reminder to send 24 hours before a booked call, with the joining link.
subject: Tomorrow: our call at {{meeting_time}}
preheader: Your joining link is inside, plus an easy way to move the call if plans have changed.

blocks.text: Speak tomorrow, {{first_name}}

A quick reminder that we are due to speak tomorrow. The details are below.

If you have a moment beforehand, think about what a good outcome would look like for {{organisation}}, and whether anything has changed since we were last in touch. We will take care of the rest.
If your plans have changed, that is no problem. Choose a new time with the link above, or reply to this email and we will sort it out.

name: Meeting reminder: 1 hour before
description: Reminder to send one hour before a booked call, with the joining link.
subject: Starting soon: our call at {{meeting_time}}
preheader: Your joining link is inside. Reply if you are running late.

blocks.text: Speak soon, {{first_name}}
Our call starts in about an hour. The joining link is below.
Running late, or has something urgent come up? Reply to this email and we will adjust.

name: Meeting rescheduled
description: Sent when a booked call moves to a new time, confirming the new details and replacing the old ones.
subject: Our call has moved to {{meeting_time}}
preheader: Updated details are inside. The previous time no longer applies.

blocks.text: New time confirmed, {{first_name}}
Thank you for your flexibility. Our call has moved; the updated details are below. Please update your calendar and disregard the earlier time.
If the new time does not work after all, reply to this email and we will find one that does.

name: Meeting cancelled
description: Sent when a booked call is cancelled, confirming the cancellation and offering a way to rebook.
subject: Our call on {{meeting_time}} is cancelled
preheader: Nothing further is needed from you. Here is how to book a new time if you want one.

blocks.text: Our call has been cancelled

Hi {{first_name}},

This confirms that our call has been cancelled, so you can remove it from your calendar.

If you would still like to talk, book a new time whenever it suits you. If your priorities have shifted, that is fine too. Your enquiry stays on record under the reference below, and you can pick it up again at any point by replying to this email.

name: Missed meeting follow-up
description: Sent after a booked call where the other person did not join, offering an easy way to rebook.
subject: Sorry we missed each other
preheader: No problem at all. Choose a new time that works better for you.

blocks.text: Let us find another time

Hi {{first_name}},

We were due to speak at {{meeting_time}} but did not manage to connect. Diaries move and inboxes fill up, so please do not worry about it.

If you would still like to talk, choose a new time below. If now is not the right moment, a quick reply saying so is fine, and we will not keep chasing.

name: Client portal or admin user invite
description: Sent when someone is given access to the Vitalos client portal or admin console and needs to accept the invitation.
subject: You have been invited to a Vitalos account
preheader: Accept the invitation to set up your sign-in. The link is personal to you.

blocks.text: Your access is ready, {{first_name}}

{{sender_name}} has invited you to a Vitalos account for {{organisation}}. Accept the invitation to set up your sign-in.

The link is personal to you, so please do not forward it.

If the link has expired, reply to this email and we will send a new one. If you were not expecting this invitation, you can safely ignore it.

We will never ask for your password by email.

name: Password reset
description: Sent when a user asks to reset the password for their Vitalos account.
subject: Reset your Vitalos password
preheader: Use the secure link inside. If you did not ask for this, no action is needed.

blocks.text: A request to reset your password

Hi {{first_name}},

We received a request to reset the password for your Vitalos account. Use the button below to choose a new one.

If you did not ask to reset your password, you can ignore this email and your current password will keep working.

For your security, we will never send your password by email or ask you for it. If you think someone else may be trying to access your account, contact support@vitalos.co.uk.
